dedupe_keys.name: hamnetdb hamnet ip database of the amateur radio data network

description: HamnetDB is the IP database of HAMNET, the high-speed amateur radio data network that links sites across Europe by radio. It records autonomous systems (regions), sites, hosts (IP addresses) and IP subnets, with a map, tools, a list of recent changes, help and documentation, and it serves as the IP coordination register for the network. The overview read lists autonomous systems by country, for example 715 in Germany, 166 in Austria, 128 in the Netherlands, 70 in France, 52 in Luxembourg, 41 each in Spain and Slovenia, 36 in Switzerland and 24 in Italy, with the time since the last edit. Access to view the database is free and public, and the content is covered by the CC BY-NC-SA licence; editing needs a login. Caveats: entries are maintained by volunteers, so currency differs by country (some were last edited years ago), and the licence does not allow commercial use. Coverage is mainly Europe. It supports network analysis and emergency communication resilience studies of a volunteer radio data network that can operate when public networks fail; related records are the ÖVSV repeater database and the amateur satellite database.
